test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 20 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following financial inclusion schemes was launched in June 2015 to prompt the unorganised workforce to join the National Pension Scheme?

options.text: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana

solution:
The correct answer is __**Atal Pension Yojana**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The government started the **Atal Pension Yojana (APY)** in June 2015 with the goal of creating a universal social security system by providing/offering guaranteed plans to all citizens, particularly the poor, underprivileged, and unorganised sector employees.
 
• The APY is administered by the **Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority (PFRDA)**.
 
• In the event of the subscriber's death, the scheme provides a guaranteed pension to the subscriber's spouse, as well as the restoration of the accumulated pension asset to the nominee.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **The Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY) Scheme **is open to persons between the ages of 18 and 70 who have a bank account and agree to join/enable auto-debit on or before May 31st for the coverage period of 1 June to 31 May on an annual renewal basis. 
 
• In India, **the Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana** is a government-sponsored life insurance programme.
 
• **The Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana **is a government of India financial inclusion programme that aims to increase affordable access to financial services such as bank accounts, remittances, credit, insurance, and pensions for Indian residents.
